Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Faux Fur Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Luxurious, 20" x 20", Ivory
Colors: Ivory
Materials: Faux Fur
Add a touch of luxury to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes glamour along with a shag texture for warmth and coziness. For a different look, flip it over to the solid ivory side. Neutral ivory enhances any style room. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
